import bpy, os, pathlib, subprocess, json
expected=os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(r'C:\mcp-blender\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'))
if os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(bpy.data.filepath))!=expected: raise RuntimeError(f'ABORTADO arquivo errado {bpy.data.filepath!r}')
tower=next(o for o in bpy.data.collections['01 WORLD | ELEVADOR LACERDA | blockout v4'].objects if 'torre documental' in o.name.lower()); up=bpy.data.objects['V4 | porta entrada placeholder']; low=bpy.data.objects['V4 | CB | porta entrada']
# datum anchored to lower urban plateau ~= 4.0 m absolute and current lower contact 0.45491 local
datum=4.0-0.4549102783203125
q={'tower':[float(tower.location.x),float(tower.location.y)],'up':[float(up.location.x),float(up.location.y)],'low':[float(low.location.x),float(low.location.y)],'datum':datum,'upper_local_z':59.5249137878418}
work=pathlib.Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\.geo-work'); py=r'C:\mcp-blender\.venv-geo\Scripts\python.exe'; script=work/'solve_upper_contact_datum.py'
script.write_text(r'''
import urllib.request,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET,json,numpy as np,math,sys
from pyproj import Transformer
q=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); target_abs=q['upper_local_z']+q['datum']; M=np.array([[1.0003134247912262,-0.0019194165053375567,-536557.3209234042],[0.0019307874108104152,1.000363623491413,-8569811.318207301],[0,0,1]],float); tx=Transformer.from_crs(4326,31984,always_xy=True); d=np.load(r'C:\mcp-blender\.geo-work\terrain_2017_candidate.npz'); pts=d['verts'].reshape(-1,3)
raw=urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request('https://api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/way/1263035782/full',headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}),timeout=30).read(); root=ET.fromstring(raw); nodes={e.attrib['id']:(float(e.attrib['lon']),float(e.attrib['lat'])) for e in root.findall('node')}; w=next(e for e in root.findall('way') if e.attrib.get('id')=='1263035782'); ll=[nodes[n.attrib['ref']] for n in w.findall('nd') if n.attrib['ref'] in nodes]; U=np.array([tx.transform(*x) for x in ll]); P=(np.column_stack([U,np.ones(len(U))])@M.T)[:,:2]
def inside(x,y,poly):
 c=False; j=len(poly)-1
 for i in range(len(poly)):
  xi,yi=poly[i]; xj,yj=poly[j]
  if ((yi>y)!=(yj>y)) and x<(xj-xi)*(y-yi)/(yj-yi+1e-30)+xi:c=not c
  j=i
 return c
xmin,ymin=P.min(axis=0); xmax,ymax=P.max(axis=0); a=pts[(pts[:,0]>=xmin)&(pts[:,0]<=xmax)&(pts[:,1]>=ymin)&(pts[:,1]<=ymax)]; a=a[np.array([inside(float(v[0]),float(v[1]),P) for v in a])]
cur=np.array(q['up']); tw=np.array(q['tower']); r0=np.linalg.norm(cur-tw); dist=np.linalg.norm(a[:,:2]-cur,axis=1); rad=np.linalg.norm(a[:,:2]-tw,axis=1); dz=np.abs(a[:,2]-target_abs); dr=np.abs(rad-r0)
print('DATUM_ABS_MINUS_LOCAL',round(q['datum'],4),'UPPER_TARGET_ABS',round(target_abs,4),'CURRENT_RADIUS',round(float(r0),3))
# candidates exact-ish elevation, report closest to current and closest preserving radius
m=dz<=0.35; idx=np.where(m)[0]; print('MATCH_COUNT',len(idx))
if len(idx):
 j=idx[np.argmin(dist[idx])]; print('CLOSEST_TO_CURRENT',np.round(a[j],3).tolist(),'MOVE',round(float(dist[j]),3),'RADIUS',round(float(rad[j]),3),'DR',round(float(dr[j]),3),'DZ',round(float(a[j,2]-target_abs),3))
 j=idx[np.argmin(dr[idx]+0.1*dist[idx])]; print('BEST_PRESERVE_RADIUS',np.round(a[j],3).tolist(),'MOVE',round(float(dist[j]),3),'RADIUS',round(float(rad[j]),3),'DR',round(float(dr[j]),3),'DZ',round(float(a[j,2]-target_abs),3))
# best if allowing 2m structural radius drift and prioritizing movement
score=dist+4*dz+2*dr; j=int(np.argmin(score)); print('BALANCED',np.round(a[j],3).tolist(),'MOVE',round(float(dist[j]),3),'RADIUS',round(float(rad[j]),3),'DR',round(float(dr[j]),3),'DZ',round(float(a[j,2]-target_abs),3))
''',encoding='utf-8')
r=subprocess.run([py,str(script),json.dumps(q)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90); print('RC',r.returncode); print(r.stdout); print(r.stderr)
if r.returncode: raise RuntimeError('falha solve datum/contato alto')
print('DATUM_UPPER_CONTACT_SOLVE_OK')
